control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident - pressure exposure at P-3220

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on P-3220 and PT-3220 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. P-3220 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during routine operation while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 30 October 2019 a potential incident was recorded on P-3220 and PT-3220 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
